visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a black Balenciaga baseball cap and a grey and white plaid shirt is seated in a black ergonomic gaming chair. He holds a translucent blue game controller with both hands and speaks excitedly toward an off-screen camera. The room is modern with light wood paneling, featuring a shelf with vintage Nintendo Game Boy Color boxes and a glowing purple neon PlayStation icon on the desk. (2) A woman with striking white hair styled in a high bun and wearing glasses appears in the background doorway. She is dressed in a yellow crop top under a blue and white varsity jacket, holding a wooden baseball bat across her shoulders. The man abruptly stops talking and turns his head to look at her with a wide-eyed, startled expression. (3) The man quickly sets the blue controller down on the desk and picks up a large black sketchbook and a pencil. He begins to frantically scribble on the paper, casting nervous glances back at the woman while pretending to be deeply engaged in work or art. The woman remains standing in the doorway, staring at him with a stern, unimpressed look. (4) The woman, still holding the bat, slowly turns away and exits the doorway, moving out of sight. The man continues his exaggerated drawing motion, looking back one last time to ensure she is gone before relaxing slightly. The camera remains static throughout the entire sequence, capturing the comical interaction in a single medium shot.
